days.summary: USA won the Teams Match 5-4 on the hill. Europe hit back with Sánchez Ruiz & Filler beating Gorst & Bergman 5-2 and debutant Aleksa Pecelj beating Skyler Woodward 5-2. Van Boening & Styer then beat Shaw & Alcaide 5-1 to level it. Full recap: billiardactiontime.com/blog/mosconi-cup-2026-day-1-results-usa-europe-level-2-2
